ability.name: Crossing the Rubicon
ability.description: Declaring war gives your units +5 strength for 10 turns. Each settlement you capture gives 50 gold per citizen.

agenda.name: Imperator
agenda.description: Respects big armies. Dislikes smaller empires that turn down his deals.

ability.name: Serpent of the Nile
ability.description: Each deal you sign gives +1 influence a turn while it lasts. Trade routes to other players give +2 gold to both sides.

agenda.name: Allure
agenda.description: Likes strong militaries. Dislikes weak ones.

ability.name: Never Defeated
ability.description: Your war support never fades. Capturing a settlement fully heals all your units.

agenda.name: Conqueror
agenda.description: Dislikes players who are at peace with everyone.

ability.name: Khan of the Steppe
ability.description: Cavalry +3 strength. Defeating an enemy cavalry unit can capture it.

agenda.name: Horde
agenda.description: Respects mounted armies. Dislikes players with few cavalry.

ability.name: Gloriana
ability.description: Naval units +1 movement and +3 strength. Coastal settlements +1 gold.

agenda.name: Queen of the Seas
agenda.description: Likes players with big navies who stay off her continent.

ability.name: Emperor of the French
ability.description: Commanders gain XP 50% faster. Units within a commander's radius get +2 strength.

agenda.name: Grand Strategist
agenda.description: Respects players with commanders and big armies. Dislikes players who beat him in war.

ability.name: A House United
ability.description: Settlements on your home continent +2 happiness. Each Industrial Zone grants a free melee unit.

agenda.name: Union
agenda.description: Dislikes players who start surprise wars. Likes players who keep their promises.

ability.name: The First Emperor
ability.description: The first military unit each city trains is free. +15% production toward Ancient and Classical wonders.

agenda.name: Wonder of the World
agenda.description: Likes players who build wonders. Envies anyone who beats him to one.

ability.name: Pilgrimage of Gold
ability.description: +1 gold for each desert tile near your settlements. Buildings can be bought with faith.

agenda.name: Richest Man in History
agenda.description: Likes players with large trade networks. Dislikes poor ones.

ability.name: The Demon King
ability.description: Melee units +5 strength when attacking a damaged unit. Gunpowder units cost 25% less.

agenda.name: Unifier
agenda.description: Respects players who take settlements. Dislikes players with weak armies.
